Specimens vary in size from approximately 0.5 to 1.5 inches in length
Condition:
Excellent natural condition. Raw specimens feature natural terminations and matrix. Polished stones exhibit a smooth finish with high surface gloss.

278316766.description:
Ken Brown
Hunt Speedball Calligraphy Kit for Left-Handers
Complete Instructional Set with Pen and Ink
11.5" x 8.75" x 2.5"
Vintage Original Edition
This specialized calligraphy kit was developed by renowned penman Ken Brown in collaboration with Hunt Speedball. Specifically engineered for left-handed artists, the set addresses the unique angles and pressure required for southpaw lettering. The kit features a comprehensive instructional method designed for ease of learning, making it a significant historical tool for traditional penmanship education during the late 20th century.
Includes four specialized calligraphy nibs and one universal pen holder
Original Super Black India Ink and instruction booklet included
Vintage packaging with period-correct graphics and original retailer labeling
Calligraphy paper stored beneath the protective styrofoam platform
Condition:
Good vintage condition. The outer box exhibits shelf wear, corner scuffing, and remains of a retail price tag. Internal components are seated in the original styrofoam insert; ink bottle is present though fluid volume and consistency may be affected by age. Nibs show signs of light previous use.
